description: A layout component that arranges child elements in a horizontal or vertical stack using CSS flexbox. Supports gap spacing, alignment, justification and wrapping.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: The orientation of the stack. Defaults to Vertical.

parameters.name: Spacing
parameters.description: The gap between items in space units (1-8). Defaults to 2.

parameters.name: AlignItems
parameters.description: How items are aligned along the cross axis.

parameters.name: JustifyContent
parameters.description: How items are distributed along the main axis.

parameters.name: Wrap
parameters.description: Whether items should wrap to the next line when they overflow.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: The content to be rendered inside the stack.
